feedback: PASS. Plan decomposes the TDD into 4 sequential tasks with clear dependencies, idempotency guard, and rollback path. Traceability matrix to TDD is complete. Effort estimates are reasonable. Warnings (non-blocking): plan is over-engineered for a one-line README append — byte-count expectations (~54 bytes), xxd 0a-byte checks, and strict wc -l=5 equality are brittle contracts inherited from the TDD; behavioral grep checks alone would suffice. ADR-002 (+2 line delta) is correctly defaulted with documented +1 fallback. No blockers.

findings.message: TASK-001 acceptance criterion records exact byte length (~54 bytes) and uses `tail -c 1 | xxd` for trailing-newline check; brittle for a trivial docs change but harmless as a recorded baseline.

TASK-003 enforces strict `wc -l == 5` and `git status --porcelain | wc -l == 1`; a successful append could spuriously fail these if any unrelated tooling touches the working tree. Behavioral grep checks (T-3, T-4) already cover the substantive requirement.
OQ-1 (+2 vs +1 line delta) is correctly defaulted to +2 per ADR-002 with explicit single-byte fallback path documented; acceptable.
TASK-004 correctly forbids git add/commit/push, deferring commits to integration phase. Good separation of concerns.
